revision_candidate.test_name: Run the Approved BERT 99.9 High-Accuracy Inference Profile
revision_candidate.purpose: Evaluate the designated GPU SUT with the engineer-approved BERT 99.9 high-accuracy MLPerf Inference release and scenario, prove model accuracy plus LoadGen/compliance validity, and compare the scenario-specific metric with a signed comparable AMD result.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact AMD or other approved GPU platform, CPU/memory/topology, driver/runtime/backend, container/harness release, BERT model/SQuAD data/preprocessing/calibration and configs. Backend and scenario are not inferred.
revision_candidate.target_scope: All resources declared by the approved configuration; BERT 99.9 only. Release, category and Server or Offline scenario must be signed. Attended 120 and Machine 150 minutes are planning values until mapped to the harness phases.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Release/category/scenario; AMD system/backend and published result ID; pinned harness/container; model/data/calibration licenses/hashes; configs; accuracy/performance/compliance commands; duration/phases; tuning; scenario-specific metric/latency and numeric comparison; health/recovery limits.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: After profile approval, verify artifact/config hashes and baseline health, then run the BERT 99.9 accuracy, scenario-specific performance and required compliance phases exactly as the pinned release documents. Capture complete evidence; do not select Server/Offline or CUDA/ROCm by assumption.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Profile/reference signed; artifacts licensed/pinned; GPUs healthy; adequate resources; tuning/load/recovery approved; no competing workload.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: System/backend identity; GPU topology; all artifact/config hashes; exact commands; BERT 99.9 accuracy; LoadGen logs and scenario-specific valid metric/latency; compliance; power/thermal/XID/ECC/host logs; reference ID and normalized comparison; final health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Signed release-specific BERT 99.9 rules and comparable AMD result. Pass requires accuracy, LoadGen/compliance validity, the correct scenario metric meeting the numeric rule and clean health; another scenario/backend/result cannot substitute.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not invent scenario/release/backend, mix 99 and 99.9, use unlicensed artifacts, copy unmatched tuning, alter clocks/power without approval, clear logs, suppress invalidity or claim official status.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Benchmark owner signs profile/reference; software/data/platform owners approve artifacts/backend/load; a human judges comparability and disposition.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Humans choose the missing profile. The Agent executes only after it is frozen and cannot use a neighboring testcase as authority.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop on invalidity or platform limit, preserve logs, terminate cleanly, restore tuning/services and verify health before an approved rerun.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Profile/reference remains unspecified; wrong model/accuracy/scenario/release/backend; missing license/config; accuracy/LoadGen/compliance failure; topology drift; XID/ECC/thermal/power/storage/host limit; evidence/monitoring loss.
